relationships.evidence_quote: Repeated injections of rosiglitazone significantly decreased the nociceptive sensitivity at 40 mmHg and 60 mmHg pressures in IBS rats (two-way repeated ANOVA, F [1, 44] = 20.58, P < 0.001, Fig. 4A).

relationships.subject: GW9662
relationships.evidence_quote: The analgesic effect of rosiglitazone on IBS was reversed by GW9662 (two-way repeated ANOVA, F [3, 40] = 5.692, P < 0.05, Fig. 5A).

key_findings: Rosiglitazone alleviated visceral hypersensitivity and anxiety in neonatal CRD rats via PPARγ, reversed by GW9662.
Spinal PPARγ and SOD were down and MDA up in IBS rats; rosiglitazone reversed this.
